claim: Ralf Berendsen is a two-Michelin-star restaurant at Paalsteenlaan 90, 3620 Lanaken (Neerharen), housed inside La Butte aux Bois.
quote: Paalsteenlaan 90, 3620 Lanaken … Two Stars: Excellent cooking.

claim: La Butte aux Bois is a Relais & Châteaux estate hotel built in 1924 as the private residence of Belgian nobleman Sir Lagasse de Locht, with 59 rooms across Manor, Villa and La Forêt.
quote: Built in 1924 as the private residence of Belgian nobleman Sir Lagasse de Locht … 59 elegant rooms and suites.

claim: La Butte aux Bois sits on a country estate overlooking Hoge Kempen National Park, minutes from the Dutch border and about 20 minutes from Maastricht.
quote: A unique country estate in an idyllic forest setting overlooking the Hoge Kempen National Park, just minutes from the Dutch border and a twenty minute drive from Maastricht.

claim: Kasteel Pietersheim, on the Domein Pietersheim estate in Lanaken, runs a 15-room hotel inside the centuries-old moated castle with two suite categories.
quote: Pietersheim Castle features a hotel with 15 rooms … Suite and Deluxe Suite.

claim: Kasteel Pietersheim sits about 1.9 km from Paalsteenlaan 90 (La Butte aux Bois / Ralf Berendsen).
quote: Hotel at Paalsteenlaan 90 is 1.9 km from Kasteel Pietersheim.

claim: Kruisherenhotel Maastricht occupies the 15th-century Kruisheren monastery and Gothic church, converted in 2005 by Camille Oostwegel into a 60-room Design Hotels member.
quote: 15th-century Kruisheren monastery … 60-room luxury design hotel, officially opening in 2005.

claim: Guests enter the Kruisherenhotel through an orange copper tunnel designed by Ingo Maurer, with stained glass and vaulted ceilings preserved.
quote: You enter through an orange copper tunnel designed by Ingo Maurer.

claim: Château Neercanne, the only terraced castle in the Netherlands, dates to 1698 and offers seven Relais & Châteaux suites plus a Michelin-starred restaurant and Bib Gourmand l'Auberge.
quote: The château dates back to 1698 … 7 rooms with a seating area … Michelin-starred Restaurant Château Neercanne and Michelin Bib Gourmand-awarded L'Auberge.

claim: Château Neercanne straddles the Belgian-Dutch border on the Cannerweg in Maastricht, with marl caves beneath the property.
quote: Château Neercanne straddles two countries – Belgium and Holland … houses a network of Marl Caves.

claim: Buitenplaats Vaeshartelt is a castle-style country estate hotel set in a 7-hectare park north of Maastricht with 84 rooms.
quote: Housed in a type of castle in Maastricht with an exceptional atmosphere and lies in a park of 7 hectares … All 84 rooms.

claim: Hotel Les Charmes is a 15-room boutique in the old Jeker district of Maastricht, with vintage decor (old leather suitcases as side tables).
quote: Boutique hotel situated in the old Jeker district … 15 guest rooms … old leather suitcases used as tables, desks, and side bed stands.

claim: Hotel Mabi occupies the former Maastricht Cinema (MaBi) in 1920s Art Deco style, with 55 rooms, a 'Cinema Plush & Bubblegum' private screening room and a Bar Twisted whiskey bar.
quote: Used to serve as the Maastricht Cinema (MaBi for short) … 55 rooms … Cinema Plush & Bubblegum, Bar Twisted.

claim: Each Mabi room is themed black-or-white, referencing the bishop's historical censorship cuts to films shown in the cinema.
quote: Each of the 55 luxury rooms has a story – either black or white … In the past, the bishop censored the most exciting cinema scenes.

claim: Hotel Zenden Maastricht spans three monumental town houses on a cobbled street, with an interior by Wiel Arets and a pool in a 700-year-old vaulted cellar.
quote: Stretches over three historic buildings … interior was designed by Wiel Arets … pool has sapphire blue waters and is located in a 700 years old vaulted cellar.

claim: Derlon Hotel sits on the Onze Lieve Vrouweplein in central Maastricht; reviews note staff service but flag dated rooms versus its four-star price.
quote: Four-star Derlon Hotel Maastricht is located directly on the Onze Lieve Vrouweplein … condition of the hotel is not more than two stars.

claim: Derlon's basement museum cellar contains free-to-visit Roman ruins where breakfast is served.
quote: Roman ruins in the basement of this hotel-restaurant are freely accessible … breakfast amongst the really interesting Roman ruins.

claim: Landgoed Kasteel de Hoogenweerth occupies a 4.5-hectare private estate on the Maas just south of Maastricht, with 10 rooms including a 250 m² Royal Castle Suite.
quote: 4.5-hectare private estate … 10 rooms total - 1 Royal Castle Suite that is over 250m2.

claim: Kasteel de Hoogenweerth stands on the banks of the Maas on a private domain just outside Maastricht city centre.
quote: Located on the banks of the river Maas on a private domain, just outside of Maastricht city centre.

claim: Château St. Gerlach in Valkenburg aan de Geul is a Relais & Châteaux estate with 114 rooms across a restored convent, farmhouse and grain lofts, plus a Roman-style spa and sculpture park.
quote: Historic buildings, including original estate farmhouse, convent and grain lofts, have been converted to accommodate 114 guestrooms … Roman-style spa with a mosaic pool, Turkish steam bath.

claim: Buitenplaats Kasteel Elsloo is a 17th-century moated castle on the Meuse in South Limburg with 26 rooms inspired by the adjacent botanical garden, plus Bar Bistro Dorine.
quote: Between 1613 and 1648 a new castle was built … 26 rooms … inspired by the flowers and plants from the botanical garden … Bar Bistro Dorine.

claim: Kasteel Elsloo is roughly 15 minutes by car from Maastricht and close to the Belgian border.
quote: Located just 15 minutes from Maastricht, close to Valkenburg and the Belgian border.

claim: A taxi from Maastricht train station to Lanaken runs about €20 and takes roughly 10 minutes (~5.6 km).
quote: Taxi fare from Maastricht Train Station to Lanaken … costs around 20.00 € … 3.46 miles (5.57 km) … about 10 minutes.

claim: ViaMichelin puts the Lanaken–Maastricht drive at about 7.5 km / 12 minutes.
quote: Driving route distance is 7.52 km with a travel time of approximately 12 minutes.

claim: Recent KAYAK bookings for Château St. Gerlach ranged from about $254 to $486 a night.
quote: Cheapest price a room at Château St Gerlach was booked for on KAYAK in the last 2 weeks was $254, while the most expensive was $486.

claim: La Butte aux Bois holds a Tablet Hotels listing as a destination property with spa, pool, sauna and the Ralf Berendsen restaurant on site.
quote: Former castle includes a state-of-the art wellness centre with a swimming pool, a sauna and a whirlpool.

claim: Château Neercanne's overnight packages guarantee a reservation at the Michelin-starred Restaurant Château Neercanne or sister Bib Gourmand L'Auberge.
quote: Guests also receive a guaranteed reservation at either the Michelin-starred Restaurant Château Neercanne or the Bib Gourmand-winning L'Auberge.

claim: Recent Kruisherenhotel reviews praise the architecture but flag costly parking and breakfast extras.
quote: Some reviewers find extras like parking and breakfast costly.
